title: opt #4 — MoE forward/backward fusion + 5090 tile retune (R65)
host_note: Xeon Platinum 8470Q, 25-core cgroup quota; eager step has a large CPU launch gap (16K full-seq step: 100.4 ms device kernels vs 162.8 ms wall), so this host is partly host-bound — see `cpu_gap_ms`.

implementation.NANOV41_MOE_FUSED_DY: NOPAD bwd no longer materialises dy_pad (zeros + tail_bwd + 2 reads); new _dw_map_kernel / _swiglu_bwd_tb_map_kernel read dout[flat_of_row//k]. Bitwise identical to the old path.
implementation.NANOV41_MOE_DWS_INLINE: dws = sum_inter acc*act0 produced as per-n-tile partial sums inside swiglu_bwd and reduced by _dws_reduce_kernel; _moe_dws and the dact write are gone.
implementation.NANOV41_MOE_FUSED_DX: dx = dgate@w1^T + dup@w3^T in one kernel (_aggemm2_t_kernel), one bf16 rounding instead of two; saves 12 launches/step but is slower per-kernel.
implementation.NANOV41_MOE_BWD_TILE: separate tile for the backward kernels (constraint BWD_BM|BM, 384%BK/BN==0)

correctness.result: 4 passed on both an RTX 4090 (torch 2.12.1/triton 3.7.1) and the RTX 5090
correctness.fused_dy: torch.equal on output and all five gradients (dx, dws, dW1, dW3, dW2)
correctness.fused_dx: only dx differs (single bf16 rounding vs two + add), rel < 5e-3; other grads bitwise
correctness.dws_inline: dws rel 2.5e-3 (pre-rounding acc vs bf16-rounded DACT in the old path); others bitwise

moe_isolated_12layers_T16384.note: wall/gap in the isolated harness are host-noisy; only kernel device time is compared.

chunked_ab.protocol: in-process interleaved A/B on the production path (hsi-auto + FP8 CE + CKPT_EVERY=2, chunk=16K), median over rounds, alternating order per round

262k.verdict: −1.2% … −3.3% (two independent runs; host noise ±0.7% per step)

1m.verdict: −1.6% … +0.5% across runs; median effect ≈ −0.3% (within run-to-run noise). MoE kernel time is only ~5.6% of the 1M chunked step, so −11.6% MoE kernel time can move the step by at most ~0.7% plus launch-gap savings.

why_opt4_gain_is_small: Report §3p ranked MoE at 28.7% of a late chunk, but that profile predates HSI (#1): after #1 the indexer no longer dominates and MoE is ~9.5% of a late chunk / ~5.6% of the 1M chunked step. Kernel-time savings of −11.6% therefore cap the end-to-end gain at ~1%.
recommended_env: NANOV41_MOE_TILE=64,64,64,4,3 NANOV41_MOE_DW_TILE=128,64,64,4,3 NANOV41_MOE_DWS_INLINE=1 NANOV41_MOE_FUSED_DY=1  (leave FUSED_DX off)

host_gap_finding.actionable: on hosts like this, cutting launch count (or CUDA-graph capture) matters more than kernel time; MoE fusion removes only ~48 of ~2000 launches/step
